drop('FRA', 'Fère-Champenoise wind farm', G, '已由逐場資料涵蓋的彙總：國家發電設施登錄在 Euvy、Fère-Champenoise 與 Corroy 三鎮 2011 年併網的只有 3 個併網點（Parc éolien d’Euvy 12.5 MW、另一個 15 MW、Corroy Énergies 17 MW，合計 44.5 MW）；前兩個是 Féréole 風場（11 部 2.5 MW、2 個併網點，2011 年投入運轉，DREAL 2026 檢查報告），第三個是 Corroy 風場（17 MW，2011），兩座本站已分別收錄，這筆 45 MW 是兩者的合計', 'An aggregate already covered farm by farm: the national register has only three delivery points connected in 2011 in Euvy, Fère-Champenoise and Corroy (Parc éolien d’Euvy 12.5 MW, another of 15 MW and Corroy Énergies 17 MW, 44.5 MW in all); the first two are the Féréole farm (11 turbines of 2.5 MW, 2 delivery points, in service since 2011, DREAL inspection 2026) and the third is the Corroy farm (17 MW, 2011), both already listed, so this 45 MW record is their sum', 'https://odre.opendatasoft.com/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/registre-national-installation-production-stockage-electricite-agrege/exports/csv?where=codefiliere%3D%22EOLIE%22%20and%20departement%3D%22Marne%22%20and%20commune%20in%20%28%22Euvy%22%2C%22F%C3%A8re-Champenoise%22%2C%22Corroy%22%29&select=nominstallation,commune,codeinseecommune,datemiseenservice,dateraccordement,puismaxinstallee,nbinstallations&order_by=datemiseenservice&delimiter=%3B'),

drop('FRA', 'Fère-Champenoise-Euvy-Corroy wind farm', G, '已由逐場資料涵蓋的彙總：國家發電設施登錄在 Euvy 有 3 個 2011 年併網的併網點（Parc éolien d’Euvy 12.5 MW、另一個 15 MW、Corroy Énergies 17 MW，合計 44.5 MW），Fère-Champenoise 鎮只有 2026 年的新機組；前兩個是 Féréole 風場（27.5 MW，2011），第三個是 Corroy 風場（17 MW，2011），本站已分別收錄', 'An aggregate already covered farm by farm: the national register has three delivery points in Euvy connected in 2011 (Parc éolien d’Euvy 12.5 MW, another of 15 MW and Corroy Énergies 17 MW, 44.5 MW in all) and only 2026 units in Fère-Champenoise itself; the first two are the Féréole farm (27.5 MW, 2011) and the third the Corroy farm (17 MW, 2011), both listed separately', 'https://odre.opendatasoft.com/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/registre-national-installation-production-stockage-electricite-agrege/exports/csv?where=codefiliere%3D%22EOLIE%22%20and%20departement%3D%22Marne%22%20and%20commune%20in%20%28%22Euvy%22%2C%22F%C3%A8re-Champenoise%22%2C%22Corroy%22%29&select=nominstallation,commune,codeinseecommune,datemiseenservice,dateraccordement,puismaxinstallee,nbinstallations&order_by=datemiseenservice&delimiter=%3B'),
fix('FRA', 'Fereole wind farm', G, '補上商轉年 2011：DREAL 2026 檢查報告說 Féréole 風場（Fère-Champenoise）有 11 部 2.5 MW 風機、2 個併網點，2011 年投入運轉；與國家發電設施登錄在相鄰 Euvy 2011 年 3 月併網的兩個併網點（12.5＋15＝27.5 MW）相符', 'Commissioning year 2011 added: the DREAL inspection report (2026) says the Féréole farm (Fère-Champenoise) has 11 turbines of 2.5 MW and 2 delivery points, in service since 2011; this matches the two delivery points the national register lists in neighbouring Euvy, connected in March 2011 (12.5 + 15 = 27.5 MW)', 'https://www.georisques.gouv.fr/webappReport/ws/installations/inspection/APZUC91LtbyADa5d3ZKrUTpiMZmg9cmb', year=2011)
note_zh: Fère-Champenoise（45 MW，2011）＝Féréole（27.5 MW）＋Corroy（17 MW）；三筆疊在一起。Corroy 這筆本身正確（登錄「CORROY ENERGIES」17 MW，2011-04-15），保留；Fère-Champenoise 刪除（第十二批併進它的 Fère-Champenoise-Euvy-Corroy 改成 drop），Féréole 補上 2011。
note_en: Fère-Champenoise (45 MW, 2011) = Féréole (27.5 MW) + Corroy (17 MW); the three overlap. The Corroy record itself is right (register “CORROY ENERGIES”, 17 MW, 15 Apr 2011) and stays; Fère-Champenoise is dropped (the round-19 dup that merged Fère-Champenoise-Euvy-Corroy into it becomes a drop), and Féréole gets 2011.
why: The Euvy rows 12.5 + 15 MW are attributed to Féréole by capacity (27.5 MW), count (2 delivery points) and year (2011); the register does not name the 15 MW row. Corroy commune has only 2022 and 2026 rows, Fère-Champenoise only 2026 rows. Note for the build: the round-19 dup of Fère-Champenoise-Euvy-Corroy must become a drop in the same commit.

proposal: fix('FRA', 'Gourgançon wind farm', G, '更正為鎮內未另列的一座：國家發電設施登錄在 Gourgançon 鎮 2021 年前只有 4 個 12 MW 併網點（合計正好 48 MW）：Erelia Champagne（即 Mont de Bézard 風場）與另一個（2007-04-23），以及 Mont Grignon 第 4、5 場（2010-10-01）；Mont de Bézard 2007 年一期與 Le Mont Grignon（24 MW，2010）本站已另列。剩下的 12 MW 是 Maurienne 的 Mont de Bézard II – Les Renardières（Gourgançon 與 Semoine，6 部風機、2 個併網點，2007 年 9 月投入運轉，2023-03-21 換新機組；DREAL 檢查報告）', 'Corrected to the one park in the commune not listed elsewhere: before 2021 the national register has only four 12 MW delivery points in Gourgançon (exactly 48 MW): Erelia Champagne (the Mont de Bézard farm) and another (23 Apr 2007), and Mont Grignon parks 4 and 5 (1 Oct 2010); Mont de Bézard’s 2007 phase and Le Mont Grignon (24 MW, 2010) are listed separately. The remaining 12 MW is Maurienne’s Mont de Bézard II – Les Renardières (Gourgançon and Semoine, 6 turbines and 2 delivery points, in service since September 2007, new machines from 21 Mar 2023; DREAL inspection reports)', 'https://www.georisques.gouv.fr/webappReport/ws/installations/inspection/my3Ga9DAqq5N5aNKpClmt5bw0mMSM4p4', mw=12, year=2007, note=True)
note_zh: Gourgançon 48 MW＝鎮內 2021 年前 4 個 12 MW 併網點的合計（GEM 依 ENGIE 2019 年資產表）；其中 36 MW 已在 Mont De Bézard（2007 一期）與 Le Mont Grignon，剩下 12 MW 是 Maurienne 的 Mont de Bézard II – Les Renardières。
note_en: Gourgançon 48 MW = the commune’s four pre-2021 12 MW delivery points (GEM, from ENGIE’s 2019 asset list); 36 MW of it is already in Mont De Bézard (2007 phase) and Le Mont Grignon, leaving Maurienne’s 12 MW Mont de Bézard II – Les Renardières.
why: The register row for the remaining 12 MW is “Confidentiel”; it is attributed to the Maurienne park because that is the only other park the DREAL reports place in Gourgançon with a 2007 start. Its capacity after the 2023 repowering is not stated (register still 12 MW). Optional: rename='Mont de Bézard II – Les Renardières wind farm'. Owner ENGIE kept (GEM source: ENGIE FY2019 analyst pack). Not to be confused with Innergex’s Les Renardières (21 MW, 2017), a separate record 9 km south.

proposal: drop('FRA', 'Melle wind farm', G, '已由逐場資料涵蓋的彙總：國家發電設施登錄在 Melle 鎮（INSEE 79174）的 5 個風電併網點合計正好 54.3 MW（12 MW 2009-12、12 MW 2011-02、14 MW 2018-07、9.4 MW 2018-08、Les Raffauds 2 6.9 MW 2020-09）；鎮內的風場本站已逐場收錄：Mont Jarron（12 MW，2009；ICPE 登記在 Melle 鎮 Mont Jarron）、Lusseray（14 MW，2018；ICPE「Ferme éolienne Lusseray-Paizay le Tort」也登記在 Melle 鎮）、3D Energies 的 La Tourette 與 Les Raffauds，以及 Paizay Le Tort；這筆是同一群風機的合計', 'An aggregate already covered farm by farm: the national register’s five wind delivery points in the commune of Melle (INSEE 79174) add up to exactly 54.3 MW (12 MW Dec 2009, 12 MW Feb 2011, 14 MW Jul 2018, 9.4 MW Aug 2018 and Les Raffauds 2, 6.9 MW, Sep 2020); the site already lists the farms in the commune one by one: Mont Jarron (12 MW, 2009; its ICPE is registered at Mont Jarron in Melle), Lusseray (14 MW, 2018; the ICPE “Ferme éolienne Lusseray-Paizay le Tort” is also registered in Melle), 3D Energies’ La Tourette and Les Raffauds, and Paizay Le Tort; this record is the total of the same turbines', 'https://odre.opendatasoft.com/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/registre-national-installation-production-stockage-electricite-agrege/exports/csv?where=codefiliere%3D%22EOLIE%22%20and%20departement%3D%22Deux-S%C3%A8vres%22%20and%20commune%3D%22Melle%22&select=nominstallation,commune,codeinseecommune,datemiseenservice,dateraccordement,puismaxinstallee,nbinstallations&order_by=datemiseenservice&delimiter=%3B')
note_zh: Melle 54.3 MW＝鎮內 5 個併網點合計；Mont Jarron（12，2009）、Lusseray（14，2018）、La Tourette（12，2011，3D Energies）、Paizay Le Tort（12，Axpo）、Les Raffauds（12，3D Energies）本站都已另列（合計 62 MW，比登錄還多），這筆再加 54.3 MW 是重複。
note_en: Melle 54.3 MW = the commune’s five delivery points; Mont Jarron (12, 2009), Lusseray (14, 2018), La Tourette (12, 2011, 3D Energies), Paizay Le Tort (12, Axpo) and Les Raffauds (12, 3D Energies) are all separate records (62 MW, already more than the register), so this 54.3 MW counts them again.
why: The 2009, 2011 and 2018 (14 MW) rows map cleanly to Mont Jarron, La Tourette and Lusseray; the 9.4 MW (Aug 2018) and Les Raffauds 2 (6.9 MW, 2020) rows map less certainly (Paizay Le Tort / Les Raffauds extension), so up to 16.3 MW may have no exact separate record — far less than the 54.3 MW double count. The DREAL inspection PDFs for the Melle parks are scanned images (no text), so the georisques API listing is used for the ICPE names.

proposal: fix('FRA', 'Miraumont wind farm', G, '更正容量與年份：這筆 46.1 MW 是 Miraumont 鎮 5 個併網點的合計；其中 2018-12-07 併網的兩個（9.9＋13.2 MW）是 Sources de l’Ancre 風場（7 部風機、2 個併網點，ICPE 登記在 Miraumont），本站已另列（23 MW）。剩下的是 H2air 的 Coquelicot 2（2A、2B 各 9.2 MW，2015-11-27 併網）與 Camomille（4.6 MW，2018-06-27 併網），合計 23 MW', 'Capacity and year corrected: the 46.1 MW is the total of the five delivery points in Miraumont; the two connected on 7 Dec 2018 (9.9 + 13.2 MW) are the Sources de l’Ancre farm (7 turbines and 2 delivery points, registered as an ICPE in Miraumont), listed separately (23 MW). The rest is H2air’s Coquelicot 2 (2A and 2B, 9.2 MW each, connected 27 Nov 2015) and Camomille (4.6 MW, connected 27 Jun 2018), 23 MW in all', 'https://odre.opendatasoft.com/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/registre-national-installation-production-stockage-electricite-agrege/exports/csv?where=codefiliere%3D%22EOLIE%22%20and%20departement%3D%22Somme%22%20and%20commune%3D%22Miraumont%22&select=nominstallation,commune,codeinseecommune,datemiseenservice,dateraccordement,puismaxinstallee,nbinstallations&order_by=datemiseenservice&delimiter=%3B', mw=23, year=2018, ph=[[2015, 18.4], [2018, 4.6]], note=True)
note_zh: Miraumont 46.1 MW＝鎮內 5 個併網點；扣掉已另列的 Sources de l’Ancre（2 個併網點 23.1 MW），剩 Coquelicot 2（18.4 MW，2015）＋Camomille（4.6 MW，2018）＝23 MW。
note_en: Miraumont 46.1 MW = the commune’s five delivery points; without Sources de l’Ancre (2 delivery points, 23.1 MW, a separate record) it leaves Coquelicot 2 (18.4 MW, 2015) + Camomille (4.6 MW, 2018) = 23 MW.
why: The two Dec 2018 rows are “Confidentiel”; they are Sources de l’Ancre by count (the only two unnamed rows; the farm has 2 delivery points and its ICPE is in Miraumont) and capacity (23.1 vs 23 MW). Optional: rename='Coquelicot 2 – Camomille wind farm'. The separate Coquelicot record (36 MW, 2016, H2Air) sits at Louvencourt, where the register has “Eoliennes du Coquelicot 1” (20.7 MW, 2018), so Coquelicot 2 is not double-counted there; that record’s own 36 MW/2016 is unverified.

proposal: fix('FRA', 'Voie Romaine wind farm', G, '更正商轉年為 2014：Global EcoPower 2014-06-26 公告 Marne 省的 La Voie Romaine 風場（22 MW）風機 2014-05-13 組裝完成、2014-06-16 併網；DREAL 2026 檢查報告說前 11 部風機 2014-07-01 投入運轉（之後另核准 2 部，全場 13 部 2 MW、26 MW）', 'Commissioning year corrected to 2014: Global EcoPower announced on 26 Jun 2014 that the La Voie Romaine farm in the Marne (22 MW) finished turbine erection on 13 May 2014 and was connected on 16 Jun 2014; the DREAL inspection report (2026) says the first 11 turbines went into service on 1 Jul 2014 (2 more were authorised later, 13 × 2 MW = 26 MW in all)', 'https://echanges.dila.gouv.fr/OPENDATA/AMF/ACT/2014/06/FCACT027058_20140626.pdf', year=2014)
note_zh: Voie Romaine：2014-06-16 併網、前 11 部 2014-07-01 運轉，紀錄的 2013 有誤。之後再加的 M1、M2 兩部（全場 26 MW）的運轉日期未寫明，容量維持 22 MW。
note_en: Voie Romaine: connected 16 Jun 2014, first 11 turbines in service 1 Jul 2014, so the record’s 2013 is wrong. The later M1 and M2 units (26 MW in all) have no stated date, so the capacity stays 22 MW.
why: The register has three Vitry-la-Ville delivery points dated 19 Jun 2014 (4 + 8 + 12.08 MW), consistent with 2014. La Guenelle (22 MW, 2013; Togny-aux-Bœufs 10 + 12.006 MW on 16 Dec 2013) is a separate farm and correct.

proposal: (no change yet) Probably GEM’s English rendering of “Voie Romaine” (Calyce’s other records are also translated: “Aeolus Masts” = Les Mâts d’Éole at Cheppes-la-Prairie); 44 MW = Voie Romaine 22 + La Guenelle 22 (both separate records, 2014 and 2013). A dup/drop needs a source tying Calyce’s 44 MW to these parks.
note_zh: Roman Road（44 MW，Calyce）很可能是 GEM 把「Voie Romaine」譯成英文（Calyce 的 Aeolus Masts 就是 Cheppes-la-Prairie 的 Les Mâts d’Éole）；44 MW＝Voie Romaine 22＋La Guenelle 22。附近 6 km 內的 ICPE 只有 Voie Romaine（13 部）、La Guenelle（11 部）、Noyales（前 Eol Team，6 部）、Les Mâts d’Éole、Cheppes la Prairie 等，沒有第三座 44 MW 的風場。
note_en: Roman Road (44 MW, Calyce) is most likely GEM’s English rendering of “Voie Romaine” (Calyce’s “Aeolus Masts” is Les Mâts d’Éole at Cheppes-la-Prairie); 44 MW = Voie Romaine 22 + La Guenelle 22. Within 6 km the only wind ICPEs are Voie Romaine (13 turbines), La Guenelle (11), Noyales (ex Eol Team, 6), Les Mâts d’Éole and Cheppes la Prairie, so there is no third 44 MW farm.
why: marne.gouv.fr (Calyce dossiers) closes the connection; no Calyce page names Roman Road / Voie Romaine. Global EcoPower built Voie Romaine for PEVR (Leonidas Associates), not Calyce. Kept as lead; a drop would rest on the name translation only.
